name: Canada

latest_census.notes: 2021 Census of Population. Religion is asked once a decade (2021 yes, 2016 no; Religion Reference Guide 98-500-X2021016). 'Ethnic or cultural origin' is a multi-response write-in (2021 changes documented in 98-20-0002), so shares are of responses and exceed 100%; 'visible minority' is an Employment Equity Act category, and Indigenous identity is a separate question. Language: mother tongue, language spoken most often at home and knowledge of official languages. Religion, ethnic origin and visible minority are long-form (sample) questions; mother tongue is on the short form for everyone -- the profile still labels all of them as census counts. Ethnocultural and religious diversity release date 26 October 2022; census-division/subdivision tables 21 June 2023.

tier_reason: All three fields are census counts published as CSV for the boundary's geographies -- 13 provinces/territories and 76 ECONOMIC REGIONS (the admin2 shapes are ERs, not census divisions) -- through two doors: www150 data tables (98-10-0178-01 mother tongue by ER; 98-10-0354-01 religion and 98-10-0357-01 ethnic origin by census division, which sum to ERs with the open.canada.ca Geographic Attribute File) and the www12 Census Profile ER download 98-401-X2021008. The www12 REST API the adapter used is bot-walled (measured) and was pointed at the wrong admin2 level anyway. Tier A rests on www150, which is a different host and has not been found blocked; if it is, Canada is B.
recommended_action: (1) Retarget the adapter away from the www12 REST API to www150 table downloads: 98-10-0178-01 (mother tongue, Canada/PT/ER -- joins admin2 directly), 98-10-0354-01 (religion, PT/CD/CSD) and 98-10-0357-01 (ethnic or cultural origin, PT/CD); take PT rows for admin1 and sum CD rows to the 76 ERs using the 2021 Geographic Attribute File from open.canada.ca. Try the WDS getFullTableDownloadCSV endpoint first (unverified pattern) and the 'downloadDataAsCustomizedLayout' link that surfaced for 9810035401 second. (2) Only if www150 is open, also try the single ER-level Census Profile CSV 98-401-X2021008 from the www12 Downloads page -- same host as the wall, so it may fail. (3) Join on ER code/DGUID (2021S0500 + 4-digit ER code) via the 2021 ER boundary file, not on the boundary's bilingual composite names ('Southern / Sud', 'Vancouver Island and Coast / *'). (4) Keep visible minority separate from ethnic origin; ethnic origin is multi-response, shares of responses. This supersedes the single province the REST adapter filled.

summary: Canada's 2021 census asks religion, ethnic or cultural origin (multi-response) and mother tongue, and StatCan publishes all three for the boundary's two geographies: 13 provinces/territories and 76 economic regions -- the admin2 shapes are ERs, not the census divisions the adapter was reading. The www12 Census Profile REST API is now bot-walled (measured), so the doors are www150's data tables -- 98-10-0178-01 mother tongue by ER directly, 98-10-0354-01 religion and 98-10-0357-01 ethnic origin by census division summed to ERs with open.canada.ca's Geographic Attribute File -- and, on the walled host, the single ER-level Census Profile CSV 98-401-X2021008. Tier A on the www150 door; B if that host turns out walled too. Join on ER codes/DGUIDs, not on the bilingual composite names.

coordinator_update_2026-09-10.measured_fact_received: www12.statcan.gc.ca answers the Census Profile REST API (CPR2021.json?dguid=...&topic=10) with an HTML bot-wall to every non-browser request; the project will not spoof a browser. Canada's 13 provinces and admin2 shapes therefore carry nothing.
coordinator_update_2026-09-10.geography_correction: The boundary's 76 admin2 shapes are StatCan ECONOMIC REGIONS, not census divisions: the packet's sample names 'Nord-du-Québec', 'Parklands', 'Regina--Moose Mountain', 'Swift Current--Moose Jaw', 'Vancouver Island and Coast' are ER names (Canada has 76 ERs in 2021; census divisions number roughly 290 and in Saskatchewan/Manitoba are called 'Division No. N'). A search result confirmed 'Vancouver Island and Coast [Economic region]' with DGUID 2021S05005910. So the adapter's GEOS 'CD' level was the wrong join target regardless of the bot-wall; any door must deliver ERs, or CDs plus a CD-to-ER aggregation.

coordinator_update_2026-09-10.tier_decision: Tier A stands, on door 1. The fields are census counts, machine-readable as CSV from www150 (a host the project has not found blocked): language directly at the 76-ER geography (98-10-0178-01), religion and ethnic origin at CD level (98-10-0354-01, 98-10-0357-01) aggregated to the 76 ERs with the open.canada.ca attribute file. Door 2's ER profile file is the simpler single download but sits on the walled host, so it is the second thing to try, not the first. If www150's download endpoint proves walled too, Canada drops to B (exists, machine-readable, not fetchable), not lower.
